description: Launch the browser and optionally navigate to a URL. On Windows, owned headless Chrome uses a private desktop and its process tree closes with the daemon, including forced termination. Headed browsers use the interactive desktop. Successful navigation responses include WebMCP availability metadata when the page exposes allowed tools.

url.description: URL to open. Omit to launch about:blank.

name: agent_browser_open
title: Open page

description: Fetch a URL as agent-readable text, preferring text/markdown. Omit url to read the active tab.

filter.description: Filter page sections, --llms links/sections, or --outline headings.

llms.description: Return nearest-ancestor llms data: index for compact llms.txt links, full for llms-full.txt.

outline.description: Return a heading outline for the selected page instead of the full page text.

raw.description: Return the response body without HTML extraction.

requireMd.description: Fail unless the response is Content-Type: text/markdown.

url.description: URL to read. Bare hosts are normalized to https. Omit to read the active tab.

name: agent_browser_read
title: Read URL

description: Return an accessibility-tree snapshot with reusable element refs.

full.description: Force full state while updating the delta baseline.

selector.description: Scope the snapshot to a CSS selector.
